newsitem.title: USA: Catalytica to buy Glaxo plant.
newsitem.headline: Catalytica to buy Glaxo plant.

text.p: Catalytica Inc said it signed a letter of intent to buy Glaxo Wellcome Plc's pharmaceutical production facility in Greenville, N.C., for an undisclosed amount.

Under the tentative agreement, Catalytica, based in Mountain View, Calif., will buy all land, buildings and equipment at the site and enter into a five-year manufacturing contract with Glaxo Wellcome for the production of Glaxo Wellcome prescription products, it said.
The contract may be worth as much as $800 million in revenue for Catalytica during that period, the company added.
Catalytica will pay Glaxo Wellcome an undisclosed sum and issue new shares to Glaxo Wellcome amounting to an equity stake in the company of less than five percent, it said.
Officials from Catalytica were not immediately available to comment further.
